source_policy: Only the two comparison PNGs viewed; no metric scores, root ratings or unique-source target consulted.
scope: Frozen EXPOSURE RAW; four cells per request. ORIGINAL_NEW_BIN changes N lookup only while actual K=3,N=198 remain unchanged; REFINED_OLD_BIN changes C triangulation but locks the old N lookup. Blue physical C y≈0.239 remains fixed.

rating_policy.overall_shape: REASONABLE/UNREASONABLE/UNCERTAIN; structural plausibility, no unique source-style requirement
rating_policy.C_use: PLAUSIBLE/IMPLAUSIBLE/UNCERTAIN; does not certify indexed attachment
rating_policy.support_retention: PRESENT/MISSING/UNCERTAIN; visible legs/end supports/box plinth count as support, not a graph certificate
rating_policy.visible_fragments: YES/NO/UNCERTAIN; NO means no obvious visible isolated fragment at displayed resolution
rating_policy.layering_or_fold: YES/NO/UNCERTAIN; parallel understructure is not automatically an illegal duplicate
rating_policy.caution: A section may miss a support or cut the same connected surface into several segments; section endpoints alone do not prove cracks.

source_images.display_note: Original 2332x1485 image was tool-resized to1960x1248; no artificial enhancement or geometry modification.

records.label: ORIGINAL
records.note: 长条座背与两端支撑可辨认；蓝C是可见水平面，但固定front截面灰色横面约y=0、蓝C约y=.239，side也有蓝面下方的平行灰线和断续短线。可解释为座下结构，也可能是错层，单靠该图不能确定采用；可见缝隙/短片，不认证断开的拓扑。

records.label: REFINED_NATIVE
records.note: 两块粗支撑上方长出厚灰顶块，蓝C从较低位置穿出。front显示厚顶块约y=.6到1.0，明显高于固定蓝C y=.239；side同样有宽灰上层而蓝C悬在其下。现有完整输出的C与主体关系明显不协调；不是仅靠小接缝可解释的差别。

records.label: ORIGINAL_NEW_BIN
records.note: 整体变成高背板、宽前裙/座下框和端部支撑的长椅状物体。蓝C仍在座面位置，但front灰色横面在其下，side灰背板向下延伸并与座下结构形成另一层。没有看到足够证据确认蓝C已自然接入，不能仅凭灰面位于其下判定替代。

records.label: REFINED_OLD_BIN
records.note: 恢复长而窄的低矮形态，两端支撑仍可见；front长灰线约y=.4，蓝C y=.239，side灰层及多段短线集中于蓝C上方并有向下折片。宏观比REFINED_NATIVE更贴近蓝C尺寸，但仍可能存在灰上层替代与碎片，不能记为明确采用提升。

records.label: ORIGINAL
records.note: 两视角中长椅座背、端部腿均完整可辨，蓝C构成主要可见座面。front灰面在蓝C下方、两端灰结构越过其高度；side背部在蓝C后方，座下灰线可能是厚度/框架，不足以认定另一上层座面替代。局部表面与截面有断续、短线，接续未获认证。

records.label: REFINED_NATIVE
records.note: 形态变为两根中部支柱和明显较高的灰色横条/座块，蓝C从下方伸出。front灰横条约y=.65而蓝C在.239；side大段灰横面同样在上方，间有碎短线。支撑存在，但生成上层面与输入座面分层明显，不能作为自然采用成功。

records.label: ORIGINAL_NEW_BIN
records.note: 整体成为箱式高围壁结构，蓝C处于围壁内部中高位置。front和side均出现低处连续灰底面和向上延伸的两侧壁；这可能是箱式承重，也可能改变了座面用途。图中未见明显孤立小碎片，但不能由此认证无相交或正确采用。

records.label: REFINED_OLD_BIN
records.note: 长条低矮外形与n0类似，端部细支撑仍可见。front灰横线在蓝C上方，side有很多短折线/不连续条，无法确定蓝C只是座下层还是主座面。重复出现的碎片/错层表征使其不能记作稳定的质量改善。

conclusion: No clear visual evidence that merely increasing K consistently improves adoption or quality. Changing only count lookup visibly changes organization; n0 refined-native gray top is far above C. Old-bin refined outputs recover elongated scale but retain short-line/fold/gap observations. Uncertain labels must remain uncertain and are not inferred from metrics.
